paper_id: Sun et al. - 2006 - RCT A Self-Adaptive Overlay for Efficient Computational Resource Discovery in Grid Systems
title: RCT: A Self-adaptive Overlay for Efficient Computational Resource Discovery in Grid Systems
motivation: 现有GIS系统不考虑应用资源需求特性,导致资源发现需遍历整个overlay
problem_framing: 计算资源发现效率受限于无分类机制的扁平overlay组织
key_insight: 按资源特征将相似资源聚类,查询时只需搜索子集而非全部资源
method_signature: 基于AVL树的自适应overlay RCT,节点管理PA值域范围
evaluation_criteria: 平均搜索长度ASL、查询负载标准差
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 并行搜索使用过期信息时会失败,需回退到普通搜索算法
evidence_for_taste: applications can be characterized by their requirements
resources can be categorized by some characteristics
queries can be processed by searching a subset
higher-level nodes are not required to maintain more information
increase their priority to be searched
thinking_moves: 将应用需求特征映射为资源组织维度
把同类资源聚合成搜索子空间以降低遍历开销
平衡二叉树结构天然支持范围查询
负载自适应通过子范围分裂合并实现而非全局重平衡
故障恢复采用备份冗余而非维护复杂父子关系
cites_own_work: [8] Early Experience of Remote & Hot Service Deployment in CROWN Grid
